language.title: Interface language
language.hint: Changes only the app's language — your word sets stay as they are.

goal.title: Daily goal
goal.hint: How many cards you want to review each day. The goal ring on the home screen fills up towards this number.

reminder.title: Daily reminder
reminder.blockedText: Allow notifications for Kolo in your browser or system settings to get reminders.
reminder.intro: A short daily nudge to review your words.

sound.title: Sound
sound.effectsDesc: Sounds for right and wrong answers and finished sessions

data.exportDesc: All your sets and words in one .json file
data.importDesc: New sets are added; sets you already have are replaced with the version from the file
data.importNote: Only Kolo backup files (.json) are supported.
data.importError: This file isn't a Kolo backup
data.noCollections: You don't have any sets to back up yet

account.title: Account
account.deleteDesc: Your account, sets, progress and achievements will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
account.confirmMessage: Your account, all sets and progress will be deleted for good.
account.deleteError: Couldn't delete your account. Sign out, sign back in and try again.
account.changePasswordDesc: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
account.passwordError: Couldn't send the email. Try again a little later.
account.logoutDesc: Your sets and progress stay — sign in again whenever you like.

tour.title: App tour
tour.hint: A quick tour of the basics: sets, practice and weekly orbits. It opens on the home screen.
